key_points: Taco Bell traffic down 12.2% after Cyclospora lettuce outbreak
Reduced foot traffic likely to pressure near‑term same‑store sales
Issue appears localized to Taco Bell, not whole Yum! Brands portfolio
Stock showed modest 1.7% gain but outperformance may be short‑lived
No new guidance or M&A; headline impact limited to near‑term earnings outlook
